title: Micro-story risk sellplay prototype
body:
Purpose and intent:
This is a prototype seller playbook that frames customer conversations as very short, repeatable micro-stories (30–60s) tied to concrete risk mitigations. The goal is to increase pilot conversion velocity by giving sellers tiny, testable scripts and a lightweight A/B experiment plan.

Who this is for:
- Field SEs and AE technical sellers running first 2–4 pilot meetings
- SDRs who want 30s contextual hooks for outreach
- Product enablement owners running a seller pilot experiment

Why micro-stories?
- Sellers struggle to remember long technical narratives. 
- 60s stories map to product outcomes (latency/cost/reliability) + a credible mitigation.
- Makes it easy to A/B test narratives and measure conversion impact.

One-line hypothesis:
If sellers use archetype-specific 60s micro-stories plus a compact risk-mitigation checklist, pilot conversion rate will improve and time-to-PO will decrease.

Micro-story grid (prototype) — use as a 1-page cheat sheet
Columns: Archetype | Primary pain | 60s micro-story (script) | Key metric to cite | Quick fallback
- Platform Engineer | Unpredictable tail latency during peak | "We helped a marketplace reduce tail latency by 3x by routing high-priority traffic to a pinned dedicated pool and introducing prefix caching for Warm sessions — net effect: 40% lower p99 and fewer 504s during Black Friday." | p99 latency, error rate | "If dedicated pools are unavailable, we fall back to a slightly higher-latency quantized model with automatic routing policies."
- Product Manager | Cost explosion on embeddings / search | "We ran a pilot that cut embedding unit costs 2.2x using workload-based quantization and intelligent embedding cache. The product team kept quality by pinning golden examples for regression checks." | Cost per embedding, relevance delta | "Start with caching + low-risk quantization and gate with evals."
- SRE / Ops | Outages during peak inference bursts | "For a fintech customer we introduced burst capacity + canary rollouts and a routing policy that diverted non-critical traffic to a lower-cost region — result: 99.95% uptime and automated fallback to safe-mode." | uptime, mean time to failover | "Canary policy + automatic rollback is built into rollouts."
- Data Scientist | Quality regressions after model swap | "We detect regressions with a prompt suite and automatic rollback; the DS team only needs to approve the post-rollout eval report. This saved their team 2 days of manual checks per release." | regression count, eval pass rate | "We can pin model versions until the DS sign-off."

Example 60s scripts (ready-to-use)
- Intro (30s hook for discovery calls): 
  "Most teams we talk to hit a point where the unpredictability of inference — latency spikes or token cost creep — starts to block product launches. We run a short pilot: 2 weeks, your feature traffic, conservative routing/caching, and a simple eval. At the end you get a delta report (latency, cost, quality) and a recommended next step. Can we map a small endpoint and try that?"

- Deeper tech (60s for platform conversations):
  "We treat serving like a runtime problem, not just an API. For example, instead of one monolithic model, we route requests by trajectory (low-latency vs high-accuracy) and use prefix KV caching to reuse context. That cuts token costs and preserves the user experience. We also recommend a canary with automatic rollback so nothing regresses in prod."

Quick objections + one-liners
- "We host our own models." -> "Totally — our Private deployment ships a control plane you keep in-VPC; many platform teams run the control plane and we manage inference runtime. Our pilot can run on your infra with a short install script."
- "Latency worries me." -> "We can pin model variants to dedicated capacity for critical paths and show a before/after p99 breakdown in the pilot report."
- "Cost is uncertain." -> "Pilot includes a cost forecast (token-level) and the Optimize module suggests batching + quantization settings that usually reduce unit costs without hurting quality. We can lock in conservative settings for the pilot."

Pilot experiment plan (A/B) — 4-week blueprint
- Objective: increase pilot->paid conversion by 15% over baseline in pilot accounts
- Arms:
  A: Control — current seller script (baseline)
  B: Treatment — micro-story grid + risk checklists + one-click rollouts demo
- Eligibility: 40 qualifying pilot opportunities over 8 weeks; balanced by ARR band and vertical
- Success metrics: pilot conversion rate, time-to-first-PO, seller-reported confidence (survey)
- Secondary metrics: number of rollback events during pilot, avg p99 improvement
- Duration & sample: run for 4 weeks per cohort or until 30 pilots complete per arm
- Instrumentation: link every pilot to a jira ticket, track conversion + dates in a shared spreadsheet, collect seller feedback forms after demo

Seller checklist (pre-demo)
- Confirm customer archetype & pick matching micro-story (one page)
- Map one endpoint or feature to use in 2-week pilot
- Confirm data access and security constraints (is Private required?)
- Add pilot to Jira (linked in the playbook) and request an SE -> assign canary owner
- Create a 5-min demo showing routing policy and fallback (screenshare)

Lightweight pilot report template (deliverable to customer)
- 1-sentence summary of outcome
- Key numbers: avg latency, p99, tokens per response, cost per 1k tokens, eval pass rate
- Recommendation: next step + risk checklist

Measurement & data collection notes
- Canonical fields to capture for each pilot (sheet): account, archetype, pilot-start, pilot-end, model(s) used, avg latency, p99, tokens, cost estimate, conversion outcome, notes
- Seller survey (post-demo): 5 Qs about clarity, credibility, and ease of pilot

Open questions / TODOs
- Need standard demo assets: short video clips for routing/fallback and a 2-slide cost simulator (Diego action)
- Create a lightweight pilot Jira template (Liam action)
- Get SEs to record 3 real micro-stories from live calls for training library (Ava lead)
- Confirm whether legal requires an additional NDA for private pilots (ask Legal)

Training and enablement plan (MVP)
- 1-pager cheat sheet (this doc condensed to 1 page)
- 30-minute enablement session with role-play (SEs practice 60s story)
- Slack channel for quick Q&A (tag: #seller-microplay)

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep stories concrete and measurable — sellers prefer a number (e.g., 2.2x cost reduction).
- Avoid heavy product-speak on first call; focus on customer pain and a low-risk pilot.
- We should run a small internal pilot with 6 SEs next week and collect NPS before rolling broader.

Appendix: example quick-email for SDRs (30–40 words)
Subject: Quick 2-week inference pilot?
Body: "Hey {name}, customers tell us unpredictable inference cost/latency is slowing launches. We run a 2-week, low-friction pilot (your traffic, conservative settings) and hand you a report showing latency, cost, and quality delta. Curious to map a single endpoint?"

Change log:
- 2025-02-11: initial draft (Priya)
- 2025-02-18: added A/B plan and micro-story grid (Diego)
- 2025-03-02: updated checklist and TODOs (Ava)

End of doc.
